annotations.title: Get a business's prices and terms

description: Get the prices of a Canopy business's bookable services, its fees and its cancellation terms, exactly as the business has them on file. Anything the business has not put on file comes back as on_file=false: tell the customer it is not on file (they can ask the business) and never estimate or fill in a value.
name: get_business_terms
